title: FHA annual mortgage insurance premium (MIP) rates, forward mortgages
issuer_of_rule: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development, Mortgagee Letter 2023-05

definitions.term: gt15 = loan term over 15 years; le15 = 15 years or less
definitions.base_loan: le726200 = base loan amount up to $726,200; gt726200 = above
definitions.ltv: loan-to-value bands as in the letter: le90 (<=90%), 90to95 (>90 to <=95), gt95 (>95); for le15: le90/gt90 (<=726,200) and le78/78to90/gt90 (>726,200)

required_qualifiers: case number assignment date on or after 2023-03-20
does_not_establish: the premium for case numbers assigned before 2023-03-20
the premium on HECM/reverse or Title I loans
the exact monthly amount, which HUD amortises on the average outstanding balance
contract.safe_sentence_template: For an FHA forward loan with a case number assigned on or after 20 March 2023, a base loan amount {base_loan} and LTV {ltv} on a term {term}, the annual MIP is {annual_mip_rate_pct} of the base loan amount (HUD Mortgagee Letter 2023-05).
